name: video-analyzer
description: Native multimodal video analysis using MiMo-V2.5. Default output is a comprehensive multi-dimensional report covering content overview, script breakdown, shot language, cinematography style, aesthetics, and competitor analysis. Also supports focused script breakdown and competitor analysis modes.
author: SOLO

modes.general: 全维度立体分析报告 (default) - 内容概览+剧本拆解+镜头语言+摄影风格+美学+竞品
modes.script: 剧本拆解 - shot-by-shot storyboard + dialogue
modes.competitor: 竞品分析 - marketing strategy + creative scoring
